title: Quick Roast Croatian Halal Roast
description: A savory, glassy-jelly croatian dish that can be prepared in no time with halal-friendly roast and vegetable shortening. This recipe is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Shortening
ingredients.notes: use enough to coat the roast

instructions: Rub the halal beef roast with vegetable shortening, making sure to coat it evenly.
Season the roast with salt and black pepper.
Place the onion, garlic, carrot, and potato in the bottom of a roasting pan, creating a bed for the roast.
Place the roast on top of the vegetables, fat side up.
Roast in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 375°F (190°C) and continue roasting for another 30-40 minutes, or until the roast is cooked to your liking.
Remove the roast from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
